# Basil Feitknecht

> Personal site and portfolio of Basil Feitknecht. BSc Computer Science ETH Zürich. Programming languages, formal methods, information security, computer systems and networks, and machine learning.

The site is one URL with two versions and one set of content. The static version is plain HTML without CSS, compiled from Typst: browsers without JavaScript get it, and any browser at `https://0xbf.ch/?static`. The dynamic version is a terminal-style Ratatui program with three frontends: the browser (WebAssembly, drawn by Ratzilla), SSH (`ssh -p 2222 0xbf.ch`, any username, no key) and native. The static version is the best source for a language model.

## Pages

- [Home](https://0xbf.ch/): Introduction, about, the selected projects with dates, and the contact list.
- [Contact](https://0xbf.ch/contact/): Email addresses, GitHub, LinkedIn, and the public keys for encrypted mail.
- [CV](https://0xbf.ch/cv): The curriculum vitae as PDF.

## Projects

- [impli](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/impli): An interpreter for the IMP language in Haskell, with a WebAssembly web frontend.
- [macho](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/ES-mini-project): Abnormal machine sound detection in C, for an embedded systems course.
- [spicky](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/spicky): A Typst cheatsheet package and template.
- [infra](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/infra): Talos Linux Kubernetes cluster across a Raspberry Pi and an Oracle Cloud node, reconciled by Flux.
- [omni](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/omni): One Nix configuration for every machine, from the laptop to the dev VM (2025 – present).
- [thyme](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/thyme): Static site generator and monochrome blog package in pure Typst.
- [apex](https://github.com/bfeitknecht/apex): This site: a dynamic version (Ratatui, in the browser, over SSH and natively) and a static version (plain HTML from Typst).
- [glob](https://blog.0xbf.ch): The blog, on programming languages, formal methods, systems, and side projects. Built with `thyme`.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://blog.0xbf.ch): Long-form posts. It has its own [llms.txt](https://blog.0xbf.ch/llms.txt).
- [Gallery](https://gallery.0xbf.ch): Standalone pieces, collections, and writings, in date order.
- [age.txt](https://0xbf.ch/age.txt) and [pgp.txt](https://0xbf.ch/pgp.txt): Public keys as plain text.
- [Sitemap](https://0xbf.ch/sitemap.xml): Every URL on the site.
